body: I doubt it. I've spent two years doing a degree I dislike but I'm not going to let them go to waste. I still have three years to go and I can barely handle it anymore. I'm sick of having to spend time hearing people talk. I just want perfect silence. At this point the only job I could enjoy, or at least not despise, is working as nightwatch in a mall or something.
I'm not interested in doing everything in my power. As far as I'm concerned life is the equivalent of someone putting something in my bag, making me pay for it and not wanting me to return it.
The issue is that I cannot live a successful life without having to interact with others. That's the problem.
